question: Should this PR wait for live WhatsApp Desktop swipe-reply proof, or may a maintainer accept the source/CI/Baileys contract evidence with an explicit proof override?
rationale: The patch is a narrow source-level fix, but the user-visible behavior is WhatsApp Desktop rendering and the PR discussion explicitly says no live capture is available.

options.title: Require live Desktop proof
